name: Catch the ten
summary: 18th-century Scottish point-trick game with a 36-card pack where capturing trump honours is decisive.
rules_text: Use a 36-card French pack, 6-Ace in each suit, 2s-5s removed; adjust by removing a 6 or all 6s to make hands even for 5,7,8 players. Deal clockwise 4-9 cards each depending on number (or 3 hands of 6 each heads-up). Turn last card for trump; in trump suit Jack is highest, then Ace-K-Q-10-9-6. Eldest leads, must follow suit if able; highest trump or highest led suit wins trick; winner leads next. Score after each trick: each side counts cards won above its fair share (36 / players * team size) = 1 point per extra card. Trump honours count: J=11, Ten=10, A=4, K=3, Q=2. Side suits score nothing except card-count. 41 points wins immediately, even mid-deal; can win during a hand. Revoke historically loses game. For 4,6,8 players may play as two alternating teams or individually; for 6 may play three teams of two.
rating_reason: Specific 36-card point-trick game with trump rules
